sql: with a as ( select pt.market_ticker tk, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) contest, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',3) rung, pt.strategy bk, case when pt.side='no' then 100-pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end ypx, pt.pnl::float pnl from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and not coalesce(pt.legacy,false) and pt.pnl is not null and pt.strategy not in (select twin_tag from live_paper_twins) and pt.market_ticker like 'KXALBUMEQUIV-%' ), r as ( select bk, contest, count(distinct rung) rungs from a group by 1,2 ), j as (select a.*, r.rungs from a join r on r.bk=a.bk and r.contest=a.contest) select 'L_entry_by_rungs'::text sec, rungs::text k, count(*)::text trades, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,1)::text avg_entry, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text pnl, round((100*sum(pnl)/count(*))::numeric,2)::text cpt, round((100.0*count(*) filter (where pnl<0)/count(*))::numeric,1)::text losspct, count(distinct contest)::text cnts from j group by 2 union all select 'M_cheapband_only', rungs::text, count(*)::text, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,1)::text, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text, round((100*sum(pnl)/count(*))::numeric,2)::text, round((100.0*count(*) filter (where pnl<0)/count(*))::numeric,1)::text, count(distinct contest)::text from j where ypx <= 7 group by 2 order by 1,2
